recs.title: Deal-closing actions
items: Start here: Levit go-live decision, today. Fatima wrote on 6 Oct that the 30 Sep code freeze slipped to 2 Oct and that today's 7 Oct quality gate is at risk. The second automation cycle found 7 P0, 16 P1 and 11 P2 issues, fixed in dev and due on staging last night. She promised the open P0/P1 count and a proposed go-live date by midday today. Insist on a dated release-readiness list (item / owner / date) and don't accept a go-live with any open P0/P1. Jira agrees: 0 of 26 Sprint 12 items are delivered, and the sprint ends Fri 9 Oct without ever being formally started.

Jimmy (Beijing Yuxiang), our #1 buyer. Odoo shows 6 of his invoices open, about €188.7k: AE000116 €66,500, AE000107 €39,900, AE000113 €38,364, AE000109 €17,300, AE000114 €13,300 and AE000120 €13,300. The reconciliation backlog may overstate this, so check the bank first, then chase whatever hasn't arrived. Quote S00392 (€13,300 TM50, 29 Sep) is still open. Cancel it if it duplicates S00374.

DR Congo contact (#3175, WhatsApp): on Sat 3 Oct you promised offers 'this week', and it's now Wednesday. WhatsApp couldn't be read today, so check your phone, send the offers and put the item and value on #3175.

Saudi projects. Aramco #2206 ($566k) has had no activity for 14 days. It's stale, so call them rather than send another email. Hyperspectral #2087 ($460k): HySpex's UK distributor Amer Alroichdi asked for a call on 5 Oct and you gave him your mobile. Get the HySpex quote alongside the pending Specim one.

Dubai Municipality drone (PO 42609661, $111.3k): your 5 Oct update to DM says the Letter of Guarantee is issued and uploaded, and testing fixes are underway. Odoo still shows AE000097 (AED 103,620) unpaid since April. Confirm whether it's actually paid, and agree the delivery date for the fixed solution.
Huliang/Liang, invoice 1715 (€29,900): still unpaid, and WH/OUT/00088 is validated. Keep the goods on hold until the money lands.
RFP #447 Trimble SX12 (budget $15k, posted from your Gmail, 0 offers): if a real buyer is behind it, put the name on Odoo #3133 and give it to a rep. The closest listing is #2177 at $20,125.

Routing you still need to decide: 33 open quotes (≈$382k) still sit under 'Contact' (EF2I €83,333, BMRC AED 57,125, Delta Star AED 85,039, Nibras €18,650). Yasar Uere's DS2000 (#3092) is with Claude, but by region it's Mireille's. This run assigned Bridgin (#2391) to Daniel and Vinoko (#3352) to Claude.

Your pipeline: 28 open opportunities, $1,287,540 expected revenue (Aramco and the hyperspectral project are about 80% of it). 287 New · 20 Qualified · 24 Proposition team-wide (331 open, ≈$2,370,098 expected revenue).
